Building services are paid for without anyone seeing the proof

The manager orders, the company works, the invoice arrives, the owners pay, and in rental buildings the cost lands in the tenants' annual statement. At every step the question is the same: was it done, and can you show it? Four changes turn that question into an obligation.

Tenants may see the evidence

More than 21 million German households receive an operating-cost statement every year, and each of them may inspect the receipts behind it. Since 1 January 2025 the landlord may provide them electronically.

Deutscher Mieterbund, 18 Dec 2025; BGH VIII ZR 66/20; § 556 Abs. 4 BGB

Whoever is liable needs the log

An owner who lets a flat answers to the tenant for the winter-service contractor hired by the owners' association as for their own fault. The contractor's log of every round becomes the owner's defence.

BGH VIII ZR 250/23, 6 Aug 2025

Invoices arrive as data

Every German business has had to accept e-invoices since 2025; issuing them becomes mandatory in 2027 for larger companies and in 2028 for all. Each line can then be checked against proven visits by code.

§ 27 Abs. 38 UStG; EN 16931

Property managers are at capacity

62.1 % of property managers report being overloaded, and 70.3 % name digitalisation their top priority. They are looking for work to take off the desk rather than for one more portal.

VDIV Branchenbarometer 2026

Rules JobFold never bends

Checks judge, code computes, people decide

Optional checks answer narrow, typed questions such as “does this message ask for extra work?”. Amounts, quantities, dates, approvals and scope are never set by a model, and no model writes a sentence that reaches a customer, a tenant or a board member.

Nothing goes out without your click

Change orders, reports, invitations, reminders and evidence links always show a preview first. Nothing is sent, approved or billed by itself.

Unknown is never zero

A missing quantity, a visit without proof and a duty without a responsible party have their own hatched style. They are never shown as done and never billed in silence.

Field staff are not tracked

Time and place are recorded only by an explicit tap or by the tag at the door. There is no background location and no ranking of individual workers, and views are team-level by default.

Shared only by grant

A service company decides per building what its manager sees. No company sees another company's prices, staff or evidence, and pages for residents show roles instead of names.

Hosted in Germany, yours to take away

JobFold and its storage run in Germany. Optional checks are off until the owner switches them on, and health, identity, salary and bank data never enter a check. Full export at any time; after cancelling, read access stays open for 90 days.

Pricing

Net prices per month for service companies, cancellable monthly, “introductory prices until 30 June 2027”. Packages include seats; extra field users are billed only in months in which they captured a visit. Customers, residents, board members and your tax advisor never pay.

Questions

Who is JobFold for?

For service companies with 1 to 30 field staff that clean, look after and clear buildings: stairwell cleaning, caretaking, winter service and grounds, later small trades. And for the property managers they work for, who read, approve and invite for free.

What is the building record?

One record per address. The service companies document their visits and extras in it, the property manager sees what each company granted and decides, the owners' board audits the costs of a period, and residents see that the work happened. Every party sees only its own part.

What does it cost a property manager?

Nothing for reading, approving and inviting, with or without an account. A paid package for operating-cost evidence, the full duty calendar and invoice checks is planned for Wave 3; no price is published yet.

Do all my service companies have to use JobFold?

No. From Wave 2 a manager can add the proof of other companies as files. It keeps its original bytes, is labelled as third-party proof with a lower evidence class and never looks like a visit captured in JobFold.

Is this legal advice?

No. Duty templates carry their source, and cost categories follow the German operating-cost regulation, but which duty applies and what is allocable is always decided and recorded by a person. JobFold computes and keeps the evidence.

Is an approval by link binding?

It is a written declaration in text form: the customer's name, a one-time code sent by e-mail (SMS is an option), a signature and a PDF, stored with the change order's version. JobFold shows its evidence class wherever it counts. It is not a qualified electronic signature.

What is an approval budget?

The property manager approves, once and with signature, an amount per month, a maximum per extra and the price-book categories that may use it. Code checks every booking against it; anything above goes the normal way with the note “Über dem Rahmen”. The manager sees every booking read-only and can revoke the budget at any time; earlier bookings stand.

How does the seal code work?

JobFold records a fingerprint of every report and approval PDF under a short code. On the public seal page anyone drops the file: the browser computes the fingerprint locally and compares it. A daily anchor with a trusted time stamp follows. The seal shows that the file is unchanged; it does not show who signed or what legal effect it has.

Does JobFold contact my customers on its own?

Never. Every change order, report, invitation, reminder and evidence link shows a preview and needs your click.

Does it work without signal?

Yes. Checklist, photos, voice notes and change-order drafts are saved on the phone at once and synced later. Unsynced data is never deleted, not even at sign-out.

Do you track my staff?

No. There is no background location tracking. Arrival and departure are explicit taps; from Wave 2 an NFC tag at the door can confirm presence on Android. It records the building and the time, never coordinates.

What does the AI see, and can I switch it off?

Checks are off by default. The owner can switch on Jev, a provider under a data processing agreement, after confirming the sub-processor entry. Checks only answer typed questions; they never set a price, quantity, date or approval, and no model writes text that reaches a customer. A screen keeps health, identity, salary and bank data out of every check. If Jev is unavailable, the rules keep running.

Does the Money Finder upload my chat?

No. The free tool on this page runs in your browser with keyword rules and cannot upload anything. In the product, imported chats are matched against each job's agreed scope, and names, phone numbers and IBANs are replaced before any optional cloud check.

Do I still need my invoicing tool?

Yes, and that is intended. Approved extras export as CSV, XLSX and DATEV format from Release 1 and arrive as drafts in Lexware Office or sevDesk from Wave 2. Property managers keep their management software; JobFold hands over files and evidence.

What happens if I cancel?

Read access and the full export stay available for 90 days. Nothing is deleted before that.

When can I start?

The public release is planned for Tuesday, 15 December 2026. Founding companies can pilot on production from mid-November. If the company registration or tax number is late, Release 1 ships with the Free plan and the trial, and paid plans start in January.
